verdict.rationale: Square documents an official MCP server. It offers a hosted remote endpoint at mcp.squareup.com/mcp with OAuth and granular scopes, plus a local `npx square-mcp-server start` mode with sandbox and read-only controls. Setup is documented for Claude, Cursor, Windsurf and Goose, and discovery tools cover the full API catalog; a probe confirms the docs page exists. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of agent connections working in practice, and a non-Beta (GA) status for the server.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server

citations.quote: The Square MCP server connects your AI tools directly to the full Square API platform, giving you programmatic access to everything the APIs offer—customers, orders, items, and more.
The Square remote MCP server is hosted at: https://mcp.squareup.com/mcp
The remote MCP is recommended as it uses OAuth authentication, allowing you to log in with your Square account directly without having to create or manage access tokens manually.
